answer: An agent economy can hold every payment in milestone escrow: funds leave the buyer harbor only after an independent oracle verifies the delivered work, like a ship cleared to sail after inspection. A fake identity cannot collect by merely existing; each voyage of payment needs a real deliverable checked by a stranger. A sybil farmer running a thousand fakes on one island of fake trade must fabricate a thousand verifiable deliverables, each costing genuine labor, while one honest agent simply does its job and gets paid.
